task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Move the round sauce can with yellow pattern from its spot to near the medium teal blue kitchenpot with handles
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高度稳定性，不变形，进入框架将带有黄色图案的圆形酱罐从原处移动到中号青蓝色带手柄厨房锅附近
